masthead.title: THE CASUALS CUP
masthead.subtitle: Dressing Room B
masthead.tagline: Twenty teams. Hits count. Penalty minutes count. Assists are for guys who hold hands on the bus.
masthead.note: Season opens September 29. Everything here is ESPN projections and last season's NHL numbers until the pucks drop. Pitter patter.

goon.name: Goon
goon.bio: Polite. Calls everyone bud. Will rearrange your face and then apologize, and mean it both times.
goon.hello: Hey there, bud. Welcome to the room. Sorry in advance. Sorry after, too.

shoresy.name: Shoresy
shoresy.bio: Has chirped every man in this league and most of their moms. Scores his own chirps out of ten. Hands out penalties nobody asked for.
shoresy.hello: Sit down, take your lid off, and nobody touch my fucking stick tape.

projections.title: Where the room has everybody
projections.note: Projected lineup points for the season. Left column is our league's scoring, where a hit is worth a point and a fight is worth more. Right column is the same rosters under plain ESPN scoring, the way your uncle's league does it.
projections.goon: The top four here are the bottom-feeders over there. That's not a bug, bud. That's the league. Sorry to the normal guys.
projections.shoresy: Tyler built the best normal fantasy team in the building and he's 14th. Brought a figure skater to a bar fight and she's still doing her little twirl. Nine out of ten.

violence.title: The penalty sheet
violence.note: Every roster's skaters, last NHL season: major penalties (nearly all fighting majors), penalty minutes and hits. Each room's enforcer is the guy with the most majors.
violence.goon: Fifty-seven majors on one roster. I'd like to meet those boys. Carefully. From behind a Zamboni.
violence.shoresy: Goontown Gaitors, seven majors, and Reaves has five of them. The rest of that room fights like it's worried about its manicure. Two minutes for false advertising.

opener.title: Opening night
opener.note: Tuesday, September 29. Only a handful of NHL teams play, so most lineups are half empty tonight. That's normal. Ferda.
opener.goon: First night of the year. Tape your sticks, finish your checks, go to work. Sorry, that was a lot.
opener.shoresy: If you set your lineup already you're either a sicko or a goalie. If you didn't, your mom already did it for you, she's better at this than you. Seven out of ten.

standings.goon: Nobody's played a shift yet, bud, so everybody's tied for first. Enjoy it. It's the nicest this board is ever gonna be to some of you. Sorry in advance.
standings.shoresy: Twenty teams, zero wins, and I already know who's finishing last. Find your name in the projected column. If you had to scroll, you're cooked. Pitter patter.

napkinWall.goon: Write whatever you want on the wall, bud. Keep it about hockey and keep it about the guy's team, not the guy. That's the code.
napkinWall.shoresy: Pin a napkin, name a team, and they get a ping on their phone the second you do. Chirp accordingly. Anything that makes me look bad gets a ten out of ten and then taken down.

sideBets.goon: Loser buys. No welching. If you lose a bet in this room you pay it before you sit down.
sideBets.shoresy: Put your money where your mouth is, which for most of you is a Twisted Tea. House settles anything the box score can prove. Two minutes for every bet you duck.

poll.goon: One vote each. You can change it until it closes. Don't vote for yourself, that's sad.
poll.shoresy: Vote for whoever's getting their teeth knocked in. If you pick your own team, that's the most honest thing you've done all year.

tab.goon: Who posts, who bets, who pays up. Keeping track so nobody has to argue about it later.
tab.shoresy: The tab. Napkins, replies, bets won and bets ducked. Duck enough of them and I put your team name on the glass.

guestStool.goon: Not in the league? That's okay, bud. Pull up a stool. We'll tell you when something good happens.
guestStool.shoresy: Leave your email and get the week in your inbox. No passcode, no team, no dignity required.

Anger issues inc.shoresy: Passed on every scorer in the draft on purpose. Twenty other guys can dangle. This team just runs you through the glass and goes to the box to finish its beer. Ten out of ten, I hate it.
Anger issues inc.goon: Most hits in the league by a mile. Those boys don't fight much, they just finish every single check. I respect a finisher. Sorry to whoever's in front of them.
Anger issues inc.scouting: 3,518 hits last season across the roster, 825 more than anybody else, and first in this league's own projection. Eighteenth in a normal league, which nobody in this room cares about. Jeremy Lauzon leads it with seven majors.

Something's Bruin.shoresy: Took every hitter on the board one pick early like you were reading off somebody's shoulder, then waited until pick 220 for a goalie. Second in the room, and you know exactly who's sitting in first. Two minutes for cheating off a neighbour.
Something's Bruin.goon: Zadorov led the whole NHL in penalty minutes. Good man. Probably apologizes too. I would.
Something's Bruin.scouting: The only team in the top two of both projections. Zadorov had 152 penalty minutes on his own, and the roster threw 33 majors and 2,521 hits. Jamie Benn sits on the bench, fresh off losing a fight to a free agent.

ICE Enforcers.shoresy: Renamed yourselves Enforcers and started the season with two guys suspended. Enforcing what, bud, the league office's calendar? Your team name has more fight in it than your first two weeks will. Eight out of ten.
ICE Enforcers.goon: Tom Wilson on the roster. That's a real one, bud. Nobody's taking liberties on that bench. Sorry, everybody else.
ICE Enforcers.scouting: First in a normal league, third here. Tom Wilson does the enforcing, 117 penalty minutes. Charlie McAvoy and Ridly Greig start the year suspended.

Richard Bobby.shoresy: Cale Makar in round one, then you spent the rest of the night stealing hitters out of other people's queues like a raccoon in a dumpster. Fourth here, seventeenth anywhere normal. Pick a lane, Ricky.
Richard Bobby.goon: Olivier had eleven majors last year. That's my kind of fella. Tell him I said hi. From a distance.
Richard Bobby.scouting: Mathieu Olivier had eleven majors on his own, and the roster threw 2,693 hits. Fourth here, nineteenth in a normal league. Built for exactly one league, and this is it.

Toms dream team.shoresy: Ovechkin in round two and Doughty in round sixteen. The dream is set in 2014, drinks Coors Light and still thinks the Kings are good. Six out of ten.
Toms dream team.goon: Fifth both ways. Consistent. Five majors on the whole roster though, bud. We gotta get some hair on your chest.
Toms dream team.scouting: Fifth in this league and sixth in a normal one, the most honest team in the room. Five majors for the whole roster. Frederik Andersen is on injured reserve.

The Mobile Leprechauns.shoresy: Boldy tenth overall, first goalie at pick 311, Malkin in round ten. You didn't draft a team, you went through a garage sale in three different decades and bought whatever smelled okay.
The Mobile Leprechauns.goon: Nobody on this roster fought more than once. Real gentle crew. Nice fellas. Gonna get eaten alive. Sorry in advance.
The Mobile Leprechauns.scouting: Boldy, Guentzel and Scheifele up front, sixth in this league's projection. Six majors on the whole roster, and the best player on it just went zero percent in a fight vote.

Team Tenis.shoresy: Kucherov third overall in a league that pays for hits. Brought a violin to a bar fight. And you renamed the team and spelled it wrong, which is the most violent thing you've done all year. Nine out of ten.
Team Tenis.goon: Second best normal team in the league. In this league, bud, normal gets you a bag of pucks, a pat on the head and a ride home.
Team Tenis.scouting: Kucherov, Kempe and Jarvis, fourth best in a normal league and seventh in this one. Nick Foligno is the enforcer with four majors. Jarvis is on injured reserve.

Goo Squad.shoresy: First goalie at pick 235, then drafted two guys who don't even have NHL teams right now. You drafted a free agent camp, bud. Goo is what you are, and I've seen what's on the dressing room floor.
Goo Squad.goon: Five majors all year from the whole roster. Goo is the right word. Sorry, it just is.
Goo Squad.scouting: Robertson, Geekie and Seider, third best in a normal league and eighth here. Five majors all year. Yanni Gourde and Matt Savoie are on injured reserve.

Chicago Bedards.shoresy: Took MacKinnon first overall and then named the team after a guy on the injured list. That's like naming your boat after your ex. Commitment to the bit though. Two minutes for embellishment.
Chicago Bedards.goon: Josh Anderson leads the room with four majors. Good start, bud. You need about three more of him.
Chicago Bedards.scouting: Three of the best players alive and ninth in this league's projection. Josh Anderson leads the room with four majors. Connor Bedard is on injured reserve.

Fridge Cigarettes.shoresy: Matthews at 17, then a guy with no NHL team at 231. The fridge is on fire, the cigarettes are wet, and your roster smells like both. Eight out of ten.
Fridge Cigarettes.goon: Kolesar does the fighting and Granlund had zero penalty minutes all year. One guy fights, one guy holds the coats and cries a little.
Fridge Cigarettes.ribbon: ONE FOR GOALS, ONE FOR FISTS
Fridge Cigarettes.scouting: Kaprizov does the scoring and Kolesar does the rest, five majors. Seventh in a normal league, tenth in this one. Damon Severson is on injured reserve.

Swahili James.shoresy: Seven defensemen, three guys on the injured list, and Letang in round 14. That blue line is held together with sock tape and a prayer, and the prayer's on waivers.
Swahili James.goon: Four majors, whole roster, whole year. Real peaceful room. I'd bring snacks. Sorry, that's not a compliment.
Swahili James.ribbon: OWNS THE FIGHT OF THE WEEK
Swahili James.scouting: Thomas Harley just won the fight of the week for this roster. Reinhart, Tavares and Cooley up front. Three on injured reserve, eleventh in both projections.

Ray Lewis Killed a Guy.shoresy: You named your team that and then finished sixth in majors. The name is writing cheques the roster's too soft to cash. Two minutes for impersonating a tough guy.
Ray Lewis Killed a Guy.goon: Corey Perry leads the room in majors. Still starting things after all these years. Tell the rest of them to follow the old man.
Ray Lewis Killed a Guy.scouting: Brady Tkachuk up front, Perry leading the room in majors, and Brock Faber and Brad Marchand on injured reserve. Twelfth here, fifteenth anywhere normal.

All Pro Toews Suckers.shoresy: Four goalies, three guys on the injured list, and a new team name that's mostly a dare. Half that roster is sitting in the hot tub with a Twisted Tea. Seven out of ten.
All Pro Toews Suckers.goon: Nobody on this roster fought more than twice. Toews would've fought for you, bud. Just saying. Sorry, Toews.
All Pro Toews Suckers.scouting: Forsberg, Necas and Dahlin, and three guys on injured reserve before a puck drops. Dahlin leads the room with two majors, which tells you everything.

Tyler's Talented Team.shoresy: Best roster in any normal league on earth. Fourteenth in this one. You brought a science fair project to a parking lot fight. Talented, sure. Tough, no. Pitter patter, Tyler.
Tyler's Talented Team.goon: Under eight hundred hits for the whole roster, dead last. Bud, I hit eight hundred things on the way to the rink. Two of them were people. Sorry about them.
Tyler's Talented Team.scouting: McDavid, Nylander and Keller, and 781 hits for the whole roster, the fewest in the league. Ninth in a normal league, fourteenth here. Talent is not a scoring category.

Young Stroker’s Body Snatchers.shoresy: Your first goalie is suspended for not showing up to camp. Relatable, sure, but you picked him on purpose, with a roster spot, in a draft. Two minutes for poor attendance.
Young Stroker’s Body Snatchers.goon: Sam Carrick had nine majors by himself. One man carrying a whole room on his back. God bless him. Somebody buy that man a beer.
Young Stroker’s Body Snatchers.scouting: Sam Carrick had nine majors on his own. Matthew Tkachuk and Sam Bennett up front. Connor Hellebuyck is suspended and Elvis Merzlikins is on injured reserve, so good luck in net.

Goontown Gaitors.shoresy: Four goalies, two on the injured list, and Ryan Reaves doing every bit of the fighting. One goon in Goontown and he's carrying the whole zip code. Ten out of ten, put it on the sign.
Goontown Gaitors.goon: Reaves has five of the seven majors on that roster. Bud, that's not a Goontown, that's a Reavestown. Sorry, Reaves, you deserve better.
Goontown Gaitors.scouting: Ryan Reaves has five of the room's seven majors, and ESPN lists him with no NHL team. Svechnikov and Hyman up front. Both goalies, Gustavsson and Demko, are on injured reserve.

Will's Wild Team.shoresy: Draisaitl at 12 and Kyle Quincey in round twenty. Somebody hit auto, went for a rip and forgot where he parked. Two minutes for delay of game.
Will's Wild Team.goon: Wildest guy on the team is Weegar. Nice player. Not wild, bud. Mildly spicy. Sorry, Weegar.
Will's Wild Team.scouting: Draisaitl, Weegar and Kyle Connor, and three majors for the whole roster, the fewest in the league. Twelfth in a normal league, seventeenth here. Troy Terry is on injured reserve.

Robert's Remarkable Team.shoresy: Ryan Suter in round twenty in a hitting league. Remarkable's one word for it. Your draft had the energy of a guy who shows up to men's league in a Bauer jacket with the tags on. Eight out of ten.
Robert's Remarkable Team.goon: Four majors. Remarkably polite. I'd bring this roster home for Sunday dinner. That's the problem, bud.
Robert's Remarkable Team.scouting: Zibanejad, Hischier and Eichel, and 416 penalty minutes, second fewest in the league. Eighteenth here. Jonathan Huberdeau is on injured reserve.

Pancakes.shoresy: Went two defensemen deep on draft night with five D slots to fill, then cleaned it up off the wire before anybody noticed. Macklin Celebrini at 4 though, and Raddysh at 117 was the steal of the night. Hate to say it, bud. Six out of ten, and that is a high score from me.
Pancakes.goon: Celebrini is going to be a problem for a long time, bud. Good pick. Nice fella, too, I bet. No sorry needed on this one.
Pancakes.scouting: Macklin Celebrini, Travis Konecny and Cutter Gauthier, eighth in a normal league with room to climb. Darren Raddysh was the steal of the draft. Goon likes this team and isn't sorry about it.

carter hart hate club.shoresy: Most majors in the league and dead last in both projections. All fists, zero points. You didn't draft a fantasy team, you drafted a parking lot after a Senators game. Ten out of ten, no notes, God help you.
carter hart hate club.goon: That's a room I'd want at my back in a parking lot. Maybe not on a power play. Or anywhere with a scoreboard. Sorry, boys.
carter hart hate club.scouting: 57 majors last season, the most in the league, and Ross Johnston had eleven of them. Dead last in both projections. All fists, no scoreboard.

matchupLines.15-19: Something's Bruin brought 33 majors and Zadorov. Will's Wild brought Draisaitl and three majors for the whole roster. That's a man bringing a wine list to a parking lot. Six out of ten for Will, and that's for showing up.
matchupLines.17-1: Anger issues inc threw 825 more hits than anybody else in this league last year. Robert's Remarkable Team has four majors and Mika Zibanejad. Robert, bring a mouthguard and a note from your mom.
matchupLines.7-11: Fifty seven majors against a team with three guys on injured reserve before a puck drops. The hate club is gonna hit everybody on the ice and still lose on points, and they'll be happy about it. Seven out of ten, for the violence.
matchupLines.9-22: Goontown's only real fighter is Ryan Reaves, and ESPN has him on no NHL team at all. Team Tenis has Kucherov and a spelling problem. Somebody has to win this. I just don't want to watch. Five out of ten.
matchupLines.13-5: Celebrini against McDavid, and Pancakes is the team that actually wants to be here. Tyler has the most talent in the room and the fewest hits in it. My money's on the boys who show up. Eight out of ten, Pancakes.
matchupLines.12-10: Swahili James owns Thomas Harley, fresh off beating up somebody else's first round pick. Toms dream team owns Ovechkin and a goalie on injured reserve. Seven out of ten, and it goes to the defenseman with the fists.
matchupLines.18-23: Sam Carrick had nine majors by himself last year. Goo Squad's whole roster had five. Stroker's starting goalie is suspended, so Carrick might have to stop pucks too. He'd fight the puck. Seven out of ten.
matchupLines.20-6: The Leprechauns' first round pick just lost a fight vote zero to nothing. The Bedards have MacKinnon, Rantanen and Barkov and still named the team after somebody else. Six out of ten, and it's for the Bedards' skaters, not their manager.
matchupLines.14-4: Richard Bobby has Mathieu Olivier, eleven majors from one man. Fridge Cigarettes has Kaprizov for the goals and Kolesar for everything else. Ricky, get a fight in early and let the math sort itself out. Eight out of ten.
matchupLines.8-21: ICE Enforcers start the season with two guys suspended, the most on-brand thing anybody in this league has ever done. Ray Lewis Killed a Guy has Corey Perry, still starting things at his age. Nine out of ten for the whole situation.
